# About Amazon

> About Amazon is the official news and information hub for Amazon's business operations, leadership, sustainability initiatives, and employee programs.

This site covers Amazon's corporate announcements, workplace culture, community impact, and technological innovations across retail, AWS, devices, and entertainment. It serves as the primary source for company news, employee development programs, and corporate responsibility initiatives.

## Employee Development & Workplace Culture

- [Amazon Future Ready](https://www.aboutamazon.com/impact/amazon-future-ready): Amazon's initiative to provide skills training and education for workforce development.
- [8 free skills training programs that help Amazon employees land higher-paying roles](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/workplace/our-upskilling-2025-programs): Overview of Amazon's upskilling programs including Leo and Technical Apprenticeships.
- [Thousands of Amazon employees are landing higher-paying jobs through Career Choice. Here's how.](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/workplace/amazon-career-choice-high-paying-jobs): Employee success stories using Amazon's Career Choice program for career transitions.
- [Amazon CEO Andy Jassy explains 8 things you may not know about the company's Leadership Principles](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/workplace/amazon-ceo-andy-jassy-leadership-principles-video-podcast): CEO Andy Jassy explains Amazon's Leadership Principles and company culture nuances.
- [LinkedIn names Amazon a top US company where people want to work for the eighth year in a row](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/workplace/amazon-linkedin-top-companies-2025): LinkedIn recognition of Amazon as top employer with focus on skills and career growth.
- [Amazon named among the top 3 most admired companies by 'Fortune' magazine for the 10th consecutive year](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/workplace/fortune-magazine-admired-companies-list-amazon): Fortune's recognition of Amazon as top 3 most admired company for 10th consecutive year.

## Sustainability & Community Impact

- [Amazon meets 100% renewable energy goal 7 years early](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/sustainability/amazon-renewable-energy-goal): Amazon achieves 100% renewable energy for all operations ahead of Climate Pledge deadline.
- [Amazon adds $1.4 billion to the housing fund to create and preserve an additional 14,000 affordable homes](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/community/amazon-housing-equity-fund-1-4-billion-investment): Amazon's $3.6B Housing Equity Fund investment across Puget Sound, Arlington, and Nashville.
- [Amazon delivers another strong year of safety progress, making our workplaces even safer for our employees](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/workplace/amazon-workplace-safety-2025-injury-reduction): Amazon's 43% workplace injury reduction and safety innovation achievements.

## Retail & Customer Experience

- [Amazon News | About Amazon](https://www.aboutamazon.com/amazon-news-today): Amazon news hub featuring latest announcements on Prime, retail, and entertainment.
- [A behind-the-scenes look at how Amazon prepares for its biggest shopping events of the year](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/operations/how-amazon-prepares-for-prime-day): Behind-the-scenes look at Amazon fulfillment center operations during Prime Day and Cyber Monday.
- [Amazon introduces faster delivery with new 1-hour and 3-hour options](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/amazon-fast-delivery-orders): Amazon's 1-hour and 3-hour delivery options expanding across US cities.
- [How Prime for Young Adults members turn everyday purchases into cash back](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/amazon-prime-young-adults-cash-back-rewards): Prime for Young Adults cash back rewards program with $145M earned by members.
- [Everything you need to know about Amazon's Big Spring Sale 2026](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/amazon-big-spring-sale-faq): FAQ guide for Amazon's Big Spring Sale with dates, deals, and Prime exclusives.

## Technology & Innovation

- [Alexa+ launches in the UK, the first country in Europe to get Amazon's next-generation AI assistant](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/devices/alexa-plus-international-launch): Alexa+ generative AI assistant launches in UK as first European market.
- [Amazon collaborates with NVIDIA on advanced AI assistants for cars](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/devices/amazon-nvidia-car-ai-assistant-collaboration): Amazon and NVIDIA partnership for in-vehicle AI assistants using Alexa Custom Assistant.
- [AWS and Cerebras collaboration aims to set a new standard for AI inference speed and performance in the cloud](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/aws/aws-cerebras-ai-inference): AWS and Cerebras partnership for optimized AI inference via Amazon Bedrock.

## Operations & Infrastructure

- [Amazon is investing AU$750 million in a robotics fulfillment center in Australia](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/company-news/australia-robotics-fulfillment-center): Amazon's AU$750M Brisbane robotics fulfillment center for 125M annual packages.
